sloka: यस्यार्थाः स च विक्रान्तो यस्यार्थाः स च बुद्धिमान्।यस्यार्थाः स महाभागो यस्यार्थाः स महागुणः ।। ६.८३.३६ ।।
transliteration: yasyārthāḥ sa ca vikrānto yasyārthāḥ sa ca buddhimān।yasyārthāḥ sa mahābhāgo yasyārthāḥ sa mahāguṇaḥ ।। 6.83.36 ।।

translations.english: He is gallant to whom wealth has flown, he is intelligent in whom wealth abides, he is glorious in whom wealth exists and he is superior in great virtues in whom wealth found receptacle.
